newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ebara shares climb to new 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Ebara shares climb to new 1997 high.

text.p: Shares in Ebara Corp climbed to a new high for this calendar year on Wednesday morning.

The manufacturer of pumps and air blowers attracted investors who expect it to benefit from a focus on global environmental problems at the Group of Seven (G7) meeting in Denver later this month, traders said.
The share price briefly hit a new high of 1,770 yen. At 0056 GMT, it was up 30 yen at 1,760. Volume was 944,000 shares.
Some traders said profits from Ebara's semiconductor-related equipment were growing and this also attracted buying.
